why: (superseded: fixed in a later round, see the round-2/3/4 entries) Which lines exist and where they go come only from BOXES, GRANTS and placement. The AI columns supply the text and nothing else: srcShort reads them; sumLinesOf builds option lines from boxOpts/RULE_OPTIONS; grantedBy, the AI label, "(name)", stratLead (phases/turn), the weapon prefix and the order are all program-built. If a summary is missing, the counted line or FN_NC is drawn and LM fails; nothing is dropped. Comparing (list, unit, placement, source, giver) across all 26 lists between f8e8966 and f9989d1 gives 1796 = 1796 distinct entries and nothing lost. The only differences are 26 stat lines (Time Flux, Relentless March) that now carry a giver, and foeOwn lines moved from When targeted to the enemy line by design. Damage numbers are identical: dmshown 675 keys and dmsingle 13222 keys, 0 differences, 0 errors. Mutations caught: deleting Guardian Organism sumDef (4 LM); dropping a Try Dat Button option (LM + LN); a stale sumAtk and a stale option (LM); a wrong number (+3" to +6", 5+ to 4+: LN); a bad or missing fingerprint (fingerprints); drawing drops for giver lines under the weapons, leader lines When targeted and foe lines under the profile (render lines-placed, ai-summary, targeted-items). Gaps found: (1) LN checks only that a number is present. A sign flip ("+1 AP" to "−1 AP"), the wrong kind ("5+ invulnerable save" to "5+ Feel No Pain") and an added contradicting number ("5+ invulnerable save (4+ vs ranged)") all pass. (2) On sheets the "Riled up (Zodgrod Wortsnagga · Super Runts: always riled up)" condition is gone: 3 lines on main, 0 now, because sumHtml/defLine summary branches skip riledWhen. render.js always-riled can no longer fire, since its regex never matches a summary line. (3) Completeness of When targeted sources still depends on the app itself: defence.js DL and render.js both take defSources from the app. Dropping other-unit sources in one list only (basic-bitch) was caught only by LM stale-summary on Psychological Saboteur. Sources shared with other lists would pass. This gap predates the branch. (4) The LM Overview filter re-implements screenPregame's regexes and leaves out the per-battle and start-of-battle table rows (e.g. "Code Chivalric (Deed 1–2)", "Resilient Organism", "Chainbreaker"), which are drawn by name only. (5) Minor: LM statShown looks up the ability by name across the army and ignores x.v (with the leftover `require('./tables') &&`), and the under-weapons lookup uses the name too, which collides on duplicate names (Praesidium Shield on Shield-Captain + Sentinel Guard Sodality). The varc row repeats the value ("A +6 +6 A vs …", Blitz Dem Gitz!) and puts "Granted by" after the bold value ("A +2 Granted by: Cybernetica Datasmith - …"). The fingerprints message still says "(gist, def)".
fix: verify/lines.js sumMisses: match each number with its sign (+1 / −1 / -1 normalised) and its unit or roll ("AP", "invulnerable save", "Feel No Pain", "cover"), and fail any number in a summary that is in neither its box labels nor its GW text (so "5+ invulnerable save (4+ vs ranged)" fails). sumHtml / defLine sum branches / statHtml: when alwaysRiled(u) and the box has a riled condition, add the program's "(always riled up: <model> · <rule>)" after the summary, and widen render.js always-riled to look at summary lines. Give defence.js DL (or LM) an independent enumeration of the other units whose defence boxes reach this unit (as L4 does for footnotes, using dmSources/reach), not A.defSources. LM Overview: take the lines from screenPregame's own ovSum calls (export the list it draws), not a copy of its regexes. LM: look up rows by abilityKey (x.v / m.key), not by name.

where: core rule line "Plunging Fire: BS/WS improved by 1 (when the rule applies)"
why: It fits "AI only in the summary column": it has no AI text and no AI label. "Plunging Fire" is the rule's name and opens GW's Core Rules text. where: Protean Purpose (Higher Imperatives) name only on the Overview
why: Rule 31 is about sheet lines: every line on every sheet. Protean Purpose has no box with a number (it only swaps the Singular Purpose pick), so it places no sheet line, the same case as rule 32. Its only appearance is the "Uses per battle" tick on the Overview, by name, which rule 31 does not cover. Non-blocking: LM exempts it as a category (an ability a rule gives with no datasheet or enhancement row), not by name the way OV_NAME_ONLY names Shadow in the Warp. A future rule-given ability on the Overview would be exempt silently. Better to list it by name in OV_NAME_ONLY.
